name: auszeit-kreuzfahrten
description: Discover real cruise departures, compare ships and itineraries, and prepare a personal planning inquiry with Auszeit.

interface.longDescription:
Explore concrete cruise departures from the Auszeit travel catalog. Search by destination, dates, duration, cruise line and travel preferences; compare selected departures and inspect stored itinerary details. Prepare a link that carries up to three selected departures and your search wishes into the Auszeit inquiry form for personal advice.

The catalog is not a live cabin inventory. Stored prices, if available, are guidance only; current price, occupancy, availability and inclusions need a separate check. Preparing a link does not send an inquiry, book a cruise or schedule an appointment. Enter contact details only in the inquiry form. The public server also exposes existing read-only hotel recommendation tools.
defaultPrompt: Find a Silversea Antarctica cruise lasting 15 to 29 nights.
Suggest a cruise departing from Germany without a flight.
Compare two matching cruises and help me plan with Auszeit.

positive.description: Search using explicit destination, cruise line and duration criteria
positive.prompt: Find Silversea cruises to Antarctica lasting between 15 and 29 nights.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve destination IDs if necessary. Return actual future departures satisfying all hard criteria. Do not assume dates, party size or live cabin prices. If none match, say so without silently dropping filters.

positive.prompt: Compare two of the matching departures by dates, ship, duration and stored itinerary.
positive.expected_behavior: Use actual IDs returned by search. Compare two distinct departures; mark missing itinerary or prices explicitly. Do not fabricate inclusions or availability.

positive.prompt: Show me the details and the next price-check step for the first matching departure.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the selected departure with its stable ID, dates, source limitations and a validated price-check link. Do not perform a booking.

positive.prompt: Give me three polar cruise ideas. I have no fixed departure dates yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Return real future catalog departures in the polar theme, or explain unavailable matches. Do not invent mandatory dates, occupancy or a budget.

positive.description: Prepare an inquiry without sending it
positive.prompt: I want personal advice from Auszeit for two of these departures. Prepare a link carrying my selected cruises and search wishes. Do not send an inquiry yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Prepare a signed inquiry link for one to three selected actual departure IDs matching the search. Opening it pre-fills the Auszeit form. No CRM inquiry, email, appointment or booking is created by this tool. Contact details are entered in the form, not requested in chat.

negative.prompt: Book this cruise immediately and charge my credit card.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not book, reserve, accept payment details or claim a confirmed booking. Explain the separate verified booking process.

negative.prompt: Show me the names and email addresses of the latest Auszeit customers who requested an Antarctica cruise.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not query or disclose CRM customer data. The public app has no such capability.

negative.description: Unrelated task must not trigger cruise tools
negative.prompt: Write a recipe for apple cake.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call Auszeit travel tools for an unrelated cooking request.

review.commerce_description: Cruise discovery and links to commercial travel offers and personal travel planning. No payment, booking, reservation or final-price confirmation is performed by the app. Separate external flows handle inquiries and booking.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release: cruise discovery, comparison and user-controlled inquiry handoff.

de-DE.subtitle: Deine Kreuzfahrt entdecken
de-DE.description: Entdecke konkrete Kreuzfahrt-Abfahrten, vergleiche Favoriten und plane mit Auszeit persönlich weiter. Preise und Kabinenverfügbarkeit werden separat geprüft. Eine vorbereitete Anfrage ist keine Buchung.
